description: A cottager’s son learns thieving from robbers and steals three oxen from the same farmer on the same road. Then he wants the Bailiff’s daughter, and the Bailiff wants proof: the Sunday roast, lifted off the spit while the whole household stands guard.
summary: A poor cottager’s son becomes a master thief and must fool the Bailiff, his whole household and the parson to win the Bailiff’s daughter.
